headline: Emory & Henry beat Catawba to top the table unbeaten
dek: Emory & Henry beat Catawba on Sunday and finished the conference season a point above them, the only side in the table without a defeat. The sides' first meeting, at Catawba in September, had ended goalless.
displaced_by: news: Emory & Henry won the rematch with Catawba and finished top of the table without a defeat

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Emory & Henry have scored 30 and conceded nine: the side top of the table got there by keeping goals out, not by scoring them.

wire.line: Catawba outscored every other side in the conference and still finished behind Emory & Henry in the table.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and the rest Emory & Henry's, the latest their home match with Palm Beach Atlantic in September.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Emory & Henry's win over Catawba on Sunday was their tenth of the season; they have drawn three and lost none.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Catawba's defeat at Emory & Henry on Sunday was their second of the season, against fourteen wins and two draws.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mars Hill have scored 42 goals, more than every other side but Catawba, and conceded 26.

last_match.line: Catawba had lost only once before, at home to Coker in October; Emory & Henry remain unbeaten.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
